description: This Java source file defines the class AndroidSdkLanguageLevelPusher, which manages updating the Java language level for Android SDKs in an IntelliJ IDEA project environment.

classes.name: AndroidSdkLanguageLevelPusher
classes.description: Manages updating Java language levels for Android SDKs within a project, listening to project root changes and applying updates accordingly.

methods.name: AndroidSdkLanguageLevelPusher
methods.description: Constructor that registers pre-startup activities to update SDK language levels and subscribe to project root changes.

methods.name: updateLanguageLevelForAllUsedSdks
methods.description: Iterates over project modules to find Android SDKs and updates their Java language levels if necessary.

methods.name: updateSdkLanguageLevel
methods.description: Updates the Java language level for a specific SDK by visiting its source files and applying the highest language level.
